blocks.html: Le Pont Residences continues to bridge Filipinos to their best life

Le Pont Residences, which translates to “The Bridge,” has linked Filipinos to their best life at the 31-hectare master-planned Bridgetowne Destination Estate (BDE). RLC Residences’ premium high-rise property launched its first tower in 2023 and is now introducing its second.

Le Pont Residences’ first tower is now 85% sold, one of the fastest-selling residential developments in the area. Aspiring homeowners can still have their slice of heaven with the remaining units or invest in the new tower. Le Pont Residences’ second tower will keep the sophisticated charm of its first tower, along with new features to look forward to.

“Le Pont Residences is both a haven and an investment opportunity. It’s only been 1 year and 6 months since we first introduced the first tower, but it already appreciated by 8% in net value, with units currently valued at Php 310K/sqm compared to the initial launch price of Php 286K/sqm. We are proud of this performance, which is much higher than the government 10-year tenor of 6.5%," reveals John Richard Sotelo, RLC Residences’ Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager and Robinsons Land Chief Marketing Officer.

The new tower features an enhanced selection of units, including bi-level penthouse units (±390 sqm) featuring an iconic curved staircase that serves as the home’s beautiful centerpiece. Tower 2 also features one (±46 sqm) - to four-bedroom (±220 sqm) homes, including an executive one-bedroom unit at ±63 sqm. All units come with loggia and thoughtful deliverables such as an engineered wood finish across the home and appliances like an air conditioner, refrigerator, cooktop, and washer and dryer, with additional dishwasher for Penthouse Units. Units also have smart home features such as A/V intercom, smart door lock, and smart switch, as well as multiple ethernet hubs and mesh devices.

Moreover, Tower 2 will access the same host of amenities offered at Tower 1, including the podium, clubhouse, work lounge, fitness deck, meeting room, pet park, swimming pools, and the tower’s own Altitude 51 - home to party units, sky lounge, and grilling area perfect for private gatherings. Furthermore, residents of Tower 2 can enjoy a new game simulation room.

Le Pont Residences has proven its future readiness distinction as it is the first and only EDGE-certified building in Bridgetowne Destination Estate. EDGE or Excellence in Design for Greater Efficiencies, is a green building standard and certification system by the International Finance Corporation (IFC) that evaluates various developments across the globe.

Moreover, the existing and upcoming developments at Bridgetowne Destination Estate will drive Le Pont Residences’ value. The destination estate is an emerging business district and lifestyle hub home to a collection of sustainable office buildings, green spaces, retail, and other full-scale commercial establishments.

Internationally certified office buildings like GBF, Campus One, Tera, Exxa, Zeta, and Giga Towers give homeowners at Le Pont Residences easy access to their workplaces. Tera Tower is certified by the Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED), while Zeta Tower is built with sustainable green building features for energy savings and an enhanced work environment.

Bridgetowne will also soon be home to premium shopping centers like Opus Mall. The luxury commercial space will have five floors of local and international brands in a world-class interior design concept.

Lastly, Fili will be the first authentic 5-star Filipino hotel. The property will combine the finest hotel offerings with modern Filipino elements, including locally crafted finishings, breathtaking skyline views, and a unique gastronomic experience.

Towering over the entire destination estate is The Victor. The 60-meter-high statue, designed by Jefrё Manuel-Figueras, is one of the world’s tallest art installations and pays homage to the resilience and unwavering determination that resides within every Filipino.

Aspiring residents can find these and more at Bridgetowne. The destination estate sits in a prime location connecting Quezon City and Pasig. Homeowners can access the rest of Metro Manila via three major thoroughfares—C5 Road, Ortigas Avenue, and Amang Rodriguez Avenue.

“We are proud of how Le Pont Residences is designed to be a one-of-a-kind residential development in Bridgetowne Destination Estate. This project is also an epitome of our Raise, Live, Connect philosophy - which is providing our residents with beautiful, well-designed homes that elevate their lifestyle, while at the same time presenting an excellent investment opportunity,” says Karen Cesario,RLC Residences’ Marketing Head and Chief Integration Officer.
Interested investors and homeseekers looking for a haven with an investment edge may connect with a Property Specialist throughrlcresidences.com.
